source: S3 OSD-314/version-6/rna_seq: Normalized_Counts, SampleTable, Unnormalized RSEM counts, contrasts, runsheet, software versions
task: does a graded gravity signal exist in the transcriptome?

design.threeLevelStatement: The 1 g samples are ground controls and the 0 g and 0.34 g samples are in orbit, so across all three levels gravity is perfectly confounded with flight. Any accuracy from that analysis includes a flight effect and cannot be reported as gravity prediction.
design.withinFlightStatement: Within flight, 0 g and 0.34 g samples come from the same mission and the same processing run, and both have red-light and dark replicates. That contrast holds flight constant and isolates 0.34 g of centrifugation.

primaryContrast.scheme: leave-one-light-treatment-out within flight (train red, test dark; train dark, test red)
primaryContrast.interpretation: Held-out light treatment is the only split here that is not a technical replicate split: the three replicates inside a (gravity, light) cell were processed together, so splitting inside a cell would score replication, not generalization. Two folds is a small evaluation and the permutation test is reported with the finite-sample correction.

corroboration.statement: The deposit's own differential expression reports thousands of genes at adjusted p < 0.05 between uG and 0.34 g inside flight, so a transcriptome difference of this size between those two conditions is the providers' finding, not an artefact of the split used here.

secondaryThreeLevel.scheme: three gravity levels, light held out — FLIGHT-CONFOUNDED, do not quote as gravity prediction
secondaryThreeLevel.whyNotPromoted: The 1 g samples are ground controls and the 0 g and 0.34 g samples are in orbit, so across all three levels gravity is perfectly confounded with flight. Any accuracy from that analysis includes a flight effect and cannot be reported as gravity prediction.

decisionRule: The within-flight contrast counts as recovered only if balanced accuracy exceeds 0.5 on held-out light treatments and its design-preserving permutation p is below 0.05. Fixed before the run.
batchCaveat: The deposited runsheet carries no sequencing-run or library-batch identifier, so a prep batch effect cannot be excluded from the deposit alone. This is a limit of the record, not a caveat that can be resolved by more analysis of the same files.
notPromotedBecause: two of the three gravity levels are confounded with flight
the only honest split yields two folds
a model trained on this would not be a predictor of partial gravity in general, and serving it as one would repeat the OSD-411 mistake with better labels
nextAction: Done in Phase 10: OSD-346 was analysed as the replication. It does not reproduce this contrast (see ml/evaluation/phase10_partial_gravity_replication.json), so the 1.000 reported here must be read as one experiment rather than as a stable property of plant transcriptomes. A servable gravity predictor would need a third mission.
